svg.title: Figure 2-1. DFA initiators against the ASIL decompositions
svg.desc: Dependent failure analysis LD-DFA-001 rev 0.16 against FSC rev 0.5: 21 dependent failure initiators in 13 categories mapped onto 11 ASIL decompositions. Initiators: 4 insufficient, 14 open, 3 safe by design. Decompositions: 10 not accepted, 1 not assessable. 25 measures with their status (10 required) and the DFA open items.
